text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Acme sandbox started getting intermittent 429s right after we enabled the sdkgateway IP-rotation flag this morning. They reported spikes during parallel onboarding tests.
Ethan Kim: thx Maya. any repro steps or logs from the client side?
Maya Patel: they sent this snippet from the worker logs — looks like immediate 429 with a short body.
Maya Patel: ```json
{"error":"rate_limited","message":"too many requests","code":429,"retry_after":1}
```
Aisha Gomez: do we see X-RateLimit headers on the response? that helps confirm it's our quota layer vs proxy cut.
Maya Patel: not in the snippet they pasted. message body only. they use sdkgateway v1.8.2 via node-sdk with connection pooling.
Ethan Kim: possible causes: 1) client parallelism overcame per-key window, 2) sdkgateway rotating IPs caused upstream to count as different clients and hit per-source token caps, or 3) JWT grace/clock skew on their rotating auth.
infra-sre: checking our gateway logs for that timeframe. can you ping me the customer request IDs?
Maya Patel: sent IDs in DM, also flagged that they have aggressive 200-concurrency workers in test.
Ethan Kim: quick checklist for them: 1) enable exponential backoff + jitter on 429s, 2) check SDK handshake retry jitter, 3) add X-Request-ID to correlate. also ask them to surface Retry-After header if present.
Aisha Gomez: small SDK snippet to add backoff (node):
```js
const backoff = (attempt)=> Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt + Math.random()*200, 10000)
// on 429: await sleep(backoff(attempt))
```
Ethan Kim: also important — if they're using short-lived JWTs and the gateway rotates outbound IP, the upstream auth service might see multiple concurrent sessions renewing and temporarily reject because of per-key minting limits. Recommend they increase JWT lifetime by a small amount while we verify rotation window.
Maya Patel: Acme confirmed they rotate client JWTs every 15s for their stress test. that seems risky.
onboard-bot: note: escalated to Tier 2 at 1902002000 by Maya Patel
infra-sre: found a pattern — our sdkgateway health-check window overlapped their rotation spikes causing bursts of re-auth calls. adjusting grace window now (rolling change).
Ethan Kim: great — infra change + customer backoff + slight increase in JWT lifetime should mitigate. can you also whitelist their sandbox static egress range while they ramp tests?
Maya Patel: requested sandbox whitelist, customer agreed. they can also throttle test harness from 200 -> 50 concurrency.
Aisha Gomez: sending the customer a short checklist and a one-pager on "safe ramping" (backoff, JWT lifetimes, concurrency caps). will include sample headers to log: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After, X-Request-ID.
Maya Patel: thanks team — will stay on this until end of day. tagging @Ethan Kim for follow-up once infra roll completes. :thumbsup:
Ethan Kim: I'll follow up once grace window is live and we'll monitor error rate and X-RateLimit headers.
Maya Patel: last update — infra rolled grace window at 1902003900, Acme lowered concurrency and reported no 429s in the last 10m. closing for now but will keep monitoring. :white_check_mark:
